name: My Explosions (FX-DEFS worked example)
description: Worked example for FX-DEFS-SIDECAR-1 (docs/modding-effects.md): retunes the stock Fireball explosion via a single data/effects/defs/Fireball.fxdef.json overlay -- no C++, no mc2.fx rebuild, no whole-blob copy. Requires MC2_FX_DEFS=1 and MC2_ACTIVE_MOD=my-explosions.
